name: Hal
description: A woman fighting corrupted townsfolk in the Ulvenwald alongside Alena, whom she loves.

timeline.summary: Hal and Alena stand back to back in a nightmarish grove of the Ulvenwald, surrounded by corrupted townsfolk.
timeline.quote: They were in a grove in the Ulvenwald, but the Ulvenwald was not the woods they had known.

timeline.summary: Hal recognizes one monster as Elder Kolman.
timeline.quote: Elder Kolman. May the angel save him.

timeline.summary: Alena's touch pulls Hal back as she nearly succumbs to the chanting.
timeline.quote: It was Alena's touch, her sweating fingers gripping Hal's wrist, that yanked Hal away from the suffocating embrace.

timeline.summary: Hal and Alena together kill the transformed Elder Kolman.
timeline.quote: Hal swung again, beheading the once-holy man.

timeline.summary: Hal and Alena flee the grove, running until they can no longer hear the chanting.
timeline.quote: They ran until they could no longer hear the chanting, until they could no longer feel the pressure in their heads.
